title: Employee Account Assignments — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
A share of the employee's cost assigned for a period, under up to seven cost elements.

It is recorded for reference; the cost engine and journal postings do not read it at present. Use Employee Wage Accounts for account mapping that postings use.

fields.label: StartDate
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.

fields.label: EndDate
fields.html: What it is. The last day this record applies.

fields.label: CostPercentage
fields.html:
What it is. The percentage of cost assigned.

Example. 50

fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Cost Element master data.
